```{r cars}

```




```{r}
library(ggplot2)
```



```{r}
library(dplyr)
df_clean <- data %>% filter(!is.na(difficultyRate) & !is.na(factualCorrectness) & !is.na(relevance) & !is.na(typeRate))

```
```{r}
type_count = df_clean %>% count(type)
ggplot(df_clean, aes(x = type)) +
  geom_bar(fill = "steelblue") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Question Types", 
       x = "Type", 
       y = "Count") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

```



```{r}
type_count <- df_clean %>% count(type)  
type_count$fraction <- type_count$n / sum(type_count$n)  
type_count$label <- paste0(round(type_count$fraction * 100, 1), "%")  

ggplot(type_count, aes(x = "", y = n, fill = type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1) +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  theme_void() +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5)) +  
  labs(title = "Distribution of Question Types")

```
